accommodation.name: St Christopher's Vienna
accommodation.notes: ✅ CONFIRMED - 6 Bed Dorm En Suite. 2 nights (Nov 1-3, 2026). Total EUR 38.97 (incl. city tax and Hostelworld deposit adjustment). Free cancellation until 2026-10-31 12:00 AM. Location: Columbusgasse 16, 10. Bezirk (near Wien Hbf).

arrival.notes: ✅ CONFIRMED - Sparschiene Komfort, 2nd class, EUR 23.00. Departs Praha hl.n. 10:08 on EC 115, changes at Pardubice hl.n. (27-min layover), continues on RJ 251, arrives Wien Hbf (Bahnsteige 3-12) 14:49 (~4h41m total). Seat reservations: EC 115 Wagen 346 window seat 95; RJ 251 Wagen 256 window seat 115. Arrives ~45 min earlier than originally planned (14:49 vs ~15:30), giving extra daylight before the ~16:45 sunset - comfortable buffer for check-in and the Prater evening walk. Note: this train departs Prague BEFORE the 11:00 hostel checkout deadline, so pack the night before.

departure.notes: ✅ CONFIRMED - Ryanair FR 51, departs Vienna (VIE) 13:45, arrives Venice/Treviso (TSF) 15:00. Seat 18A, Priority & 2 carry-on bags included. Price 38.91 EUR. Passenger: Martin Lambrecht. ⚠️ This departure time means the Schönbrunn morning visit needs to wrap up with enough buffer to get to VIE airport (~45 min from city center via CAT/train) and through security. Ryanair requires mobile boarding pass via app - no printed passes accepted.

timeBlocks.description: Arrival from Prague (Wien Hbf 14:49), check-in at St Christopher's Vienna, buy transport pass.

activities.name: Arrival & Check-in at St Christopher's Vienna
activities.notes: Not yet booked - reserve ahead. Near Westbahnhof (U3/U6).

activities.name: Buy 72-Hour Wiener Linien Transport Pass
activities.notes: Buy via WienMobil app - covers all metro/tram/bus for the full stay. Cheaper than individual tickets after ~3 rides/day.

timeBlocks.name: evening
timeBlocks.description: Prater by night (Riesenrad lit up), then Stephansplatz walk and dinner.

activities.name: Prater & Riesenrad (Giant Ferris Wheel)
activities.notes: Chosen deliberately as an evening activity - the Riesenrad is lit up and running at night, making darkness work in its favor rather than against it. Walk the park for free, or ride the wheel for the view. Public transport: U1/U2 to Praterstern, 2 stops.
activities.opening_hours: Evening hours vary seasonally, check before going
activities.cost: free to walk, ~14 EUR for Riesenrad ride

activities.name: Stephansplatz & St. Stephen's Cathedral (exterior, night)
activities.notes: Iconic Gothic cathedral, multi-colored tile roof. Exterior view at night; free entry to back section only (skipping interior/paid areas this trip).

activities.name: Dinner (recommendation, not fixed)
activities.notes: See food_recommendations.restaurants for options - Figlmüller (classic schnitzel, reservation recommended) or SPAR Gourmet (Kärntner Ring 2) for a cheap hot schnitzel sandwich if keeping costs down.

alternatives.name: Schönbrunn Palace (Day 1 evening)
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Sunset on Nov 1 is ~16:45; an evening arrival leaves too little daylight to enjoy the gardens/Gloriette walk properly. Moved to Day 3 morning instead, when it benefits from full daylight.

research_notes.notes: Nov 1, 2026 is both a Sunday and Allerheiligen (All Saints' Day) - a public holiday in Austria. Most retail shops closed; restaurants and tourist sites generally open but worth double-checking hours.

days.title: Parliament, Graben & Kohlmarkt, Karlskirche, State Opera

timeBlocks.name: morning
timeBlocks.description: Free guided Parliament tour (book exact slot online in advance), then stroll Graben and Kohlmarkt to the Hofburg.

activities.name: Austrian Parliament - Guided Tour
activities.timeRestriction: Reserve exact slot online in advance - fills up
activities.notes: Free guided tours, offered in multiple languages - book online ahead. Airport-style security check, bring passport (required). After the tour, go up to the terrace for views toward the Hofburg.

bookingDetails.advanceTimeNeeded: Book as early as possible - slots fill up

activities.opening_hours: Check official site for tour times

activities.name: Graben & Kohlmarkt
activities.notes: Preferred over Rathaus/Votive Church - lively pedestrian streets with real movement and energy (shops open on Monday), Plague Column on Graben, elegant Kohlmarkt leading straight to the Hofburg gates.

activities.name: Hofburg (exterior) & St. Michael's Church
activities.notes: Hofburg exterior only (skipping paid interior/Sisi Museum this trip). St. Michael's Church is free entry, right at the Hofburg gate, easy to combine.

timeBlocks.name: lunch
timeBlocks.description: Lunch recommendation - not fixed, pick based on mood/budget.

activities.name: Lunch (recommendation, not fixed)
activities.notes: See food_recommendations.restaurants - SPAR Gourmet (cheap hot schnitzel sandwiches, ~5-8 EUR) if keeping costs down, or a sit-down at Figlmüller if not done the night before.

activities.name: Karlskirche (St. Charles's Church)
activities.timeRestriction: Tickets online only - no door sales
activities.notes: Go inside - altar and ceiling are spectacular, ticket includes rooftop terrace access via lift for great city views. Also check the small architectural model/tiny museum on the way up. MUST buy tickets online in advance.

bookingDetails.advanceTimeNeeded: Book before arrival - no door sales

timeBlocks.name: evening
timeBlocks.description: Vienna State Opera guided tour, then Stephansplatz at night and dinner/dessert.

activities.name: Vienna State Opera - Guided Tour
activities.timeRestriction: Multiple tour times daily - check schedule
activities.notes: One of the world's most prestigious opera houses, neo-Renaissance façade, lavish marble/gold interior. Guided tours available in multiple languages, giving a glimpse into the building's history and backstage.

bookingDetails.advanceTimeNeeded: Book ahead, several tour times per day

activities.name: Stephansplatz at Night (revisit)
activities.notes: Optional second pass by the cathedral on the way to dinner.

activities.name: Dinner & Dessert (recommendation, not fixed)
activities.notes: See food_recommendations for dessert cafe options (Demel or Gerstner recommended over the touristy Café Sacher queue) and dinner spots.

alternatives.name: Rathaus & Votive Church
alternatives.reason_not_selected: User prefers Graben/Kohlmarkt (lively, shops open, more movement/energy) over these two 'look and move on' exteriors.

alternatives.name: Albertina

research_notes.notes: This is the main activity day - all three priority bookings (Parliament, Karlskirche, Opera) are scheduled here since Nov 2 is a regular Monday (Nov 1 being a Sunday/holiday made it the safer choice for paid/reserved activities).

timeBlocks.name: morning
timeBlocks.description: Schönbrunn Palace gardens and Gloriette (exterior/grounds only), then back to the hostel to checkout. Shortened slightly from the original plan to leave a comfortable buffer for the 13:45 flight.

activities.name: Schönbrunn Palace Gardens & Gloriette
activities.notes: Deliberately scheduled as the LAST-day morning activity for full daylight (benefits from being seen in daylight rather than evening). Take U4/U1 from Favoriten area (~25-30 min). Walk the vast, beautifully maintained gardens with ornate fountains. Steep but worthwhile climb up to the Gloriette for sweeping views over the palace and city. Skipping the interior (expensive, time-consuming) per the guide's own recommendation - exterior and gardens are the real highlight. Shortened to ~2 hours (from the original 2.5h) to leave room for the confirmed 13:45 flight.
activities.opening_hours: Gardens typically open from early morning

activities.name: Checkout from St Christopher's Vienna
activities.timeRestriction: Hostel check-out by 11:00 at the latest
activities.notes: Pack and check out. Allow ~25-30 min to get back from Schönbrunn.

timeBlocks.name: afternoon
timeBlocks.description: Transfer to Vienna International Airport (VIE) and confirmed Ryanair FR 51 departure to Venice/Treviso.

activities.name: Transfer to Vienna International Airport (VIE)
activities.notes: From Favoriten, take the S7 (Schnellbahn) or a taxi/Uber to VIE (~30-45 min depending on route). CAT (City Airport Train) runs from Wien Mitte if more convenient. Arrive with plenty of buffer for a 13:45 departure.
activities.cost: 4-30 EUR depending on mode (S7 cheapest, taxi priciest)

activities.name: Ryanair FR 51 to Venice/Treviso (TSF)
activities.timeRestriction: Departure 13:45, mobile boarding pass required (Ryanair app - no printed passes accepted)
activities.notes: ✅ CONFIRMED - Ryanair FR 51, Vienna (VIE) → Venice/Treviso (TSF). Departs 13:45, arrives 15:00. Seat 18A, Priority & 2 carry-on bags included. Booking ref QYWZ9E. Price 38.91 EUR. Download Ryanair app for the digital boarding pass before arriving at the airport.

must_try_dishes.description: Breaded, pan-fried veal or pork cutlet, tenderized thin and fried to a light, crispy texture. The definitive Vienna dish.

Dense chocolate cake layered with apricot jam, covered in glossy chocolate icing. Contested origin between Hotel Sacher ("Original Sachertorte", two apricot layers) and Demel ("Eduard-Sacher-Torte", one layer).
Marzipan and raspberry jam cake topped with smooth white fondant, named after Empress Elisabeth ("Sisi"). Signature dessert at Gerstner.
The most iconic Viennese coffee house drink, similar to a cappuccino - espresso with steamed milk and foam.
Homemade spinach dumplings, a classic Viennese specialty found alongside schnitzel on traditional menus (e.g., Figlmüller).
Eggs poached in a spiced tomato sauce - recommended specifically at ULRICH cafe.
Modern French-inspired pastry hybrid - flaky croissant with a cookie-dough layer, signature item at CRO bakery.

drinks_and_rituals.description: Historic coffee houses (Café Sacher, Demel, Gerstner) were gathering places for writers/artists/thinkers (Freud, Klimt, Schiele, Kafka). Order a Melange and linger - no pressure to rush.
drinks_and_rituals.typical_time: Any time, popular mid-morning or afternoon

restaurants.name: Figlmüller - Restaurant Bäckerstraße
restaurants.notes: Established 1905, THE place for schnitzel in Vienna. Reservation recommended due to popularity.

restaurants.name: SPAR Gourmet
restaurants.notes: Not a joke - genuinely great for cheap, convenient on-the-go lunches between attractions. Self-checkout, cash and card.

restaurants.name: Demel
restaurants.notes: Founded 1786, former court confectioner. Watch pastry chefs through a glass window. Recommended over the touristy Café Sacher queue.

restaurants.name: Gerstner K. u. K. Hofzuckerbäcker
restaurants.notes: Open since 1847, one of the city's oldest patisseries, served Emperor Franz Joseph I.

restaurants.name: URBAN's Lounge Restaurant
restaurants.typical_cost_per_person: 18-28 EUR (10-14 EUR with The Fork app discount)
restaurants.notes: High quality in a great location. Book through The Fork app for discounts (up to 50% seen).

restaurants.name: Pizza Mari
restaurants.notes: Imports ingredients directly from Naples. Indoor or outdoor Schanigarten seating in warmer months.

restaurants.name: CRO
restaurants.notes: Cozy French-inspired bakery cafe, good for breakfast/snack. Outdoor seating for people-watching.

restaurants.name: Ramasuri
restaurants.notes: Local favorite for breakfast/brunch, laid-back vibe, outdoor seating.

restaurants.name: ULRICH
restaurants.notes: Stylish, minimalist interior, menu changes with the seasons.

restaurants.name: Freyja - the croissant story
restaurants.notes: Modern bakery, Scandinavian-inspired minimalist design, elevated Viennese pastry-making.

special_meal_formats: The Fork app - book restaurants for 30-50% off food bill in Vienna; confirm discount is applied before paying
tourist_traps_to_avoid: Horse-and-carriage rides around St Stephen's Cathedral - extremely high prices, inauthentic experience, documented animal welfare concerns
Café Sacher - historic and famous but often long queues; Demel or Gerstner recommended as better-value alternatives for the same style of cake

average_food_budget_reference.note: Rough daily food budget guide for Vienna (per person)
average_food_budget_reference.breakfast: 4-8 EUR (bakery/cafe) up to 14-20 EUR (brunch spot like Ramasuri)
average_food_budget_reference.lunch: 5-8 EUR (SPAR Gourmet/on-the-go) up to 18-28 EUR (sit-down restaurant)
average_food_budget_reference.dinner: 20-30 EUR (schnitzel at Figlmüller) up to 12-18 EUR (casual pizza)
average_food_budget_reference.daily_total_estimate: ~35-60 EUR/day eating casually/mid-range, more if doing sit-down dinners at places like Figlmüller regularly

ticket_types: 7-day pass (Wochenkarte) - ~17.10 EUR but Mon-Sun only, not ideal for a Sun-Tue stay

where_to_buy.app: WienMobil app - buy, display, and validate digital tickets instantly, no manual validation needed

operating_hours.standard: ~05:00 to midnight for most of the network
operating_hours.night: Night buses every 30 min until ~05:00; Fri/Sat nights the metro runs all night with trains every 15 min

bike_rentals.notes: Good option for the Ringstrasse loop on Day 2 if preferred over tram/metro.

practical_tips: Nov 1, 2026 is Allerheiligen (All Saints' Day), a public holiday - most retail shops closed, but restaurants and tourist attractions generally open.
Vienna is extremely card-friendly - Apple Pay/cards accepted almost everywhere. Carry a small amount of cash only for public toilets or rare cash-only spots.
If withdrawing cash, use BAWAG, Erste Bank, or Raiffeisenbank ATMs (no operator fees) - avoid bright-orange Euronet ATMs (high fees, poor conversion).
When paying by card, always choose to pay in EUR, not your home currency.
Tipping is modest - if a service charge is already on the bill, no extra tip expected; otherwise round up to the nearest ten.
English is very widely spoken - German is not a barrier for tourists.
Karlskirche and other sights may require online-only ticket purchase - no door sales, so book before arrival.
